title: Canadian Start-up smartARM Uses AI to Create Intuitive Bionic Prosthetics
facebook: This Canadian startup's AI-powered bionic arm can "see" what you're holding and automatically adjust its grip — think picking up a coffee cup or a pen without any extra effort. It's making everyday tasks easier for amputees. https://aiworldhq.com/article/ai-powered-prosthetics-how-smart-bionic-arms-work-and-who-they-re-for
